description: Market breadth for one of the 13 stock markets in the latest session: how many tracked companies rose and fell, the share of dollar volume in the rising ones, the share above normal volume, new 52-week highs and lows, and the share above the 50-day average, in two or three sentences with the session date. No prices or price changes.

market.description: Market key or name, e.g. US, Japan or Germany. Default US. Any of the 13 markets.

window.description: 1D, the latest session (the only window given). Default 1D.

name: infinity_market_breadth
title: Market breadth
